title: POST JSON Handler
prompt:
Create an Express server that accepts JSON POST requests.

**Requirements:**
1. Import `express` and create an app instance
2. Use `app.use(express.json())` to enable JSON body parsing
3. Add a POST route at `/api/items` that reads the request body and returns `{ created: true, item: req.body }`
4. Export the app as the default export
hints: Define a POST route with: app.post('/api/items', handler)
The request body is available as req.body
